sources.scope: 203 valid, distinct IMIP municipal Predios geometries verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Ciudad Juárez WUP locator, which lies in a returned full polygon. GlobalID is the publisher-declared per-feature identity; OBJECTID is transport identity, and clavetxt remains only a label. The earlier clavetxt-based full-grid exact read matched 23,424 source rows because the label 0 is repeated, so that descriptor is rejected without filtering out such rows. Complete object-ID manifests, forced three-row paging of 31 source features over eleven geometry pages, all 203 fresh GlobalID reads, valid synthetic UUID absence, footprint and binding passed. Independent GEOS in EPSG:32613 found all 203 valid, nonduplicate and no sampled positive-area overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. A malformed non-UUID absence probe correctly returned HTTP 400 and is preserved separately. All source shapes and labels remain unchanged. Citywide completeness, GlobalID continuity after publisher replacement, survey accuracy and legal-title semantics remain unverified.
sources.licenceNote: Public municipal parcel-reference cartography; notices informational. Legal title, survey accuracy and GlobalID continuity after publisher replacement unverified.
